caption: A horse gallops across an open field from one end to the other.

sa.check: A horse gallops across an open field.
It goes from one end to the other.

pc.expect: The legs move in a galloping sequence and bend at the joints, and the mane and tail stream back.
pc.fail: The legs move in pairs like a rocking horse; or a leg bends mid-bone; or the legs pass through each other.

pc.expect: There are moments when all four hooves are off the ground and then they come back down, the body rising and falling with the strides.
pc.fail: It glides with hooves never lifting; or floats up and stays; or sinks into the ground.

pc.expect: The hooves land on the turf.
pc.fail: They sink deep into the turf; or pass through a fence; or the turf passes through the hooves.

pc.expect: It travels steadily across the field.
pc.fail: It jumps position between frames; or runs backward; or freezes mid-stride in the air.

pc.expect: One horse keeps its legs and shape.
pc.fail: A leg detaches or vanishes; or a second horse appears from it; or it turns into another animal.

pc.expect: The horse's coat and the field stay the same.
pc.fail: The coat changes colour; or the field rearranges; or the fence changes.

note: The horse is self-driven: its speed and path are not judged.
